Where This Started

From random food nights
to something real.

01

It started with late nights, a kitchen, and people who couldn't stop eating. House parties turned into cooking sessions. Every single time, someone said the same thing — "You need to do this professionally."

02

Raghav has been feeding people — travelers, hostel guests, friends, strangers — the way someone feeds you when they actually care. Not a recipe. Not a service. A genuine experience.

"The food is unreal. But more than that — the feeling around it. That's what made me want to be part of whatever this becomes."

Now it's time to build it properly. A cloud kitchen in Bangalore — built from the ground up, community-first, with people who want to be more than just customers. This is the beginning, and you're reading this early for a reason.

The real people behind every meal. This is what Spicy Studio already feels like.
